title: Service Coordinator / Administration Officer (Full-Time)
description:
Company: Iris Home Care



🕑Working hours: 8:00 am–5:00 pm, 



🗓️Monday–Friday, Brisbane time (AEST)

Starting rate: Approximately AUD $4.35 per hour, depending on verified experience



🪻About the position

Iris Home Care is an Australian disability-support provider. We are looking for a warm, confident and highly organised Service Coordinator who can build genuine rapport while ensuring important actions are followed through.



This is a highly interactive, people-facing position. It is not a quiet, low-contact or purely administrative role. You will regularly communicate by telephone,
 and online messaging with participants, families, support workers, providers and other stakeholders.



You do not need to be the loudest person in the room. However, you must be comfortable initiating conversations, asking appropriate questions, speaking up when something requires attention and communicating with people who have different personalities and needs.



Key responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



- Building professional and respectful relationships with participants.

- Completing regular participant check-ins by telephone,
 or video call.

- Coordinating participant services, appointments, activities and support arrangements.

- Communicating with participants, families, nominees, support workers, providers and other relevant stakeholders.

- Monitoring participant goals, service-delivery progress, changing needs, barriers and risks.

- Helping participants identify practical actions that support their goals.

- Following up outstanding actions and ensuring agreed tasks are completed.

- Identifying concerns, service gaps or risks and escalating them promptly.

- Liaising with support workers about participant goals, activities and service expectations.

- Supporting participant enquiries, intake, onboarding and administrative processes when required.

- Maintaining accurate case notes, communication records, task updates and participant information.

- Assisting with service-capacity enquiries and appropriate lead-generation activities.

- Protecting confidential participant and business information.

- Managing several priorities while maintaining accuracy and professional communication.



👣About you

We are looking for someone who is:



- Highly proficient in spoken and written English.

- Clear, confident and easily understood over the telephone.

- Warm, positive, energetic and naturally engaging.

- Comfortable making calls and initiating conversations.

- Able to build rapport quickly while maintaining professional boundaries.

- Calm, respectful and empathetic when someone is distressed, frustrated or experiencing strong emotions.

- Proactive and willing to investigate solutions instead of waiting for every instruction.

- Resourceful, accountable and reliable with follow-up actions.

- Capable of managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Highly organised and attentive to detail.

- Comfortable working with sensitive and confidential information.

- Confident learning and using different online systems.



Relevant experience may include service coordination, case management, disability support, healthcare, mental health, community services, customer service, client relationship management or another people-focused coordination role.



Experience with the Australian NDIS or disability-support sector is highly regarded but is not essential if you have strong transferable experience and are willing to learn.



👩🏼‍💻Systems used

We use:



- ChatGPT

- Google Workspace

- ClickUp

- Astalty

- Approved telephone, communication and rostering systems



Previous experience with these systems is helpful. More importantly, you must be confident with technology, able to learn quickly and willing to troubleshoot basic issues.



🎁Lead-generation bonus

This position will contribute to lead generation by responding professionally to enquiries and communicating our current service capacity. Our social-media platforms have a combined audience of approximately 14,000 followers.



An additional AUD $50 bonus is available for each participant lead personally generated by you who:



1. Successfully completes onboarding;

2. Receives at least two shifts of support; and

3. Has their first two invoices paid.



Working arrangements



The ordinary work schedule is 8:00 am–5:00 pm, Monday–Friday.



The position may also require approximately one Saturday per month during the position’s usual working hours. The exact Saturday arrangement, break arrangements and paid hours will be confirmed before appointment.



✋🏼How to apply

Please reply with a short voice recording introducing yourself. Speak naturally rather than reading from a prepared script.



In your recording, please tell us:



- A little about yourself and your personality.

- Your current or most recent position.

- Your relevant experience.

- Why the Service Coordinator position suits you.

- Your hobbies or interests.

- When you are available to commence.

- Whether you can work the required Monday-to-Friday hours.

- Whether you can work approximately one Saturday per month if required.



We will use the voice recording to assess spoken English, clarity, confidence, warmth and overall communication style. Applications without a voice recording may not progress.



Please read the requirements carefully before applying. This role will not suit everyone. If the starting rate, working hours, telephone requirements or highly interactive nature of the work do not suit you, there is no obligation to proceed. We would prefer an honest decision now than waste your time or ours.

title: Meta Ads Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced and data-driven Full-Time Meta Ads Specialist to lead the strategy, execution, and optimization of all paid social advertising campaigns across Meta platforms 
, Instagram, Messenger) for a portfolio of diverse agency clients. This is a highly strategic, client-facing role that requires a mastery of performance marketing fundamentals combined with a strong creative intuition and a dedication to staying ahead of platform algorithm shifts.



The ideal candidate not only knows how to execute, but is also fluent in the latest AI-driven delivery systems, such as the Andromeda update, and understands the new imperative of creative diversification over hyper-specific audience targeting.



Key Responsibilities



I. Campaign Strategy & Optimization (The Science)



Client Performance Ownership: Plan, launch, manage, and scale high-performing campaigns across multiple client accounts and the entire marketing funnel (TOFU, MOFU, BOFU) to meet aggressive ROAS/CPA targets.



Advanced Targeting: Utilize a deep understanding of audience segmentation, including Custom Audiences, Lookalikes (LALs), and Advantage+ Audience parameters, to maximize signal density and conversion efficiency tailored to each client's unique target demographic.



Platform Expertise (Post-Andromeda): Structure campaigns for success in Meta’s evolving AI-driven environment. This includes consolidating campaign structures, embracing broad targeting, and leveraging Advantage+ automation tools for budget and placement optimization.



Tracking & Data Health: Ensure flawless implementation and maintenance of the Meta Pixel and Conversions API to ensure clean, high-quality data reporting and optimal ad delivery signals for every client property.



Budget Management: Rigorously monitor campaign spend, perform daily optimizations, and manage bids and budget allocations (CBO/Advantage+ Budget) to maximize efficiency and scale across your assigned client portfolio.



II. Creative Strategy & Storyboarding (The Art)



Creative as the New Targeting: Proactively lead the creative strategy, recognizing that ad creative is the primary lever for performance in the current Meta landscape.



Storyboarding & Visual Planning: Suggest, plan, and formalize storyboards and visual concepts for new ad creatives, focusing on mobile-first, vertical video (Reels/Stories) formats.



A/B Testing Discipline: Implement a rigorous, continuous creative testing framework (e.g., 8-15 distinct creative concepts per campaign) to consistently refresh the ad library and combat ad fatigue.



Collaboration: Serve as the critical bridge between the Media Buying team and the Content/Design teams, ensuring all visual and copy assets are briefed correctly, align with platform best practices, and address specific audience angles.



III. Reporting & Platform Intelligence



Client Analysis & Reporting: Analyze performance data daily, weekly, and monthly, translating complex metrics (e.g., CPM, CTR, ROAS, New Customer Ratio) into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations for client presentations and internal stakeholders.



Innovation & Updates: Stay current with all major platform updates, policy changes, and algorithmic shifts (e.g., Andromeda, iOS updates). Implement necessary changes immediately to maintain account performance and compliance.



Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of all campaign setups, testing results, and optimization protocols.



Required Skills & Qualifications



3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience managing and scaling high-budget paid advertising campaigns on Meta platforms 
 and Instagram).



Proven ability to manage and prioritize multiple client accounts and diverse campaign objectives simultaneously, ideally within an agency setting.



Expert-level proficiency in Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager, including deep knowledge of setting up Conversion Tracking, Catalog Feeds, and Dynamic Ads.



Demonstrable understanding of AI-driven ad delivery changes and how to adapt strategy to new automated systems (e.g., the importance of creative density and broad targeting in the current ad auction environment).



Proven visual aptitude and creative thinking with experience outlining and briefing impactful ad concepts/storyboards for video and static formats.



Exceptional analytical skills, highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets, and the ability to interpret data beyond surface-level metrics.



Strong communication skills, capable of presenting complex performance data and creative rationale to stakeholders.



Meta Blueprint certification(s) strongly preferred.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Facelove Cosmetics is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer beauty brand built for women over 40, with a strong presence across the US and EU markets. 



The Role



We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to own end-to-end hiring for our e-commerce and creative functions — from writing job descriptions through sourcing, screening, and offer coordination. You'll work closely with our HR Manager and hiring stakeholders to keep our contractor and full-time pipelines full of strong, vetted candidates.



This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a coordination-only role. You'll be expected to source proactively, run structured screens, and bring sharp judgment to who's actually a fit — not just who looks good on paper.



What You'll Do



Manage full-cycle recruitment for e-commerce (media buying, growth, ops) and creative (design, video, content, strategy) roles

Write and refine job descriptions that attract the right candidates and filter out the wrong ones

Source candidates proactively through LinkedIn, job boards, and other channels — not just wait for inbound applicants

Screen resumes and portfolios, run initial interviews, and produce structured, comparable candidate assessments for hiring managers

Coordinate interview scheduling across time zones with hiring managers and founders

Draft and help negotiate offers, and support onboarding handoff for new hires

Maintain a clean, up-to-date pipeline in our hiring systems (GoHire, LinkedIn Recruiter)

Flag pipeline or spec issues early — if a role's requirements are producing no viable candidates, bring evidence and options rather than continuing to source blindly

Spot resume and portfolio red flags (inflated experience, reused/scraped creative work, unverifiable claims) before they reach final interviews



What You'll Need



3+ years of recruitment experience, with a track record hiring specifically for e-commerce and creative roles

Experience recruiting for DTC or performance-marketing-driven companies is a strong plus

Comfortable evaluating creative portfolios (design, video, content) as well as more traditional e-commerce/ops backgrounds

Excellent written communication; you can write both a sharp JD and a warm, human candidate

Ability to work core hours aligned to CET

Comfortable working independently in a fully remote, fast-moving environment

Experience with hiring/ATS tools such as GoHire and LinkedIn Recruiter is a plus



How you work



- You move fast and d

- You want ownership, not a brief

 is increasingly rewarding original content, so the goal is to identify winning patterns and create our own original concepts.

High Point International Inc. helps B2B SaaS executives build high-conviction growth engines. We are looking for an analytical, hands-on growth strategist to bridge the gap between ad spend and bottom-line revenue.



Mission



Drive scalable pipeline growth for B2B SaaS clients by executing full-funnel paid media campaigns and establishing closed-loop CRM attribution. You will solve tracking blind spots, optimize multi-channel performance, and deliver clear, data-backed acquisition strategies that translate marketing investments into qualified demos, pipeline, and predictable revenue.

- Build, manage, and optimize multi-channel paid acquisition campaigns across Google Search, Demand Gen, LinkedIn, Meta, and emerging platforms like OpenAI Ads, Reddit, and CTV.



- Establish end-to-end tracking and attribution integrity using Google Tag Manager, GA4, UTM frameworks, and CRM integrations (HubSpot/Salesforce) to connect ad interactions directly to pipeline and revenue.



- Conduct continuous channel experimentation, evaluating new platforms for audience fit, cost efficiency, creative requirements, and measurement capabilities.



- Manage campaign mechanics including targeting, keyword strategy, bid structures, budget allocation, and continuous creative/landing page testing.



- Translate complex performance data into clear narrative reporting for executive stakeholders, highlighting CAC, opportunity creation, ROI, and strategic next steps.



- Collaborate cross-functionally with creative, content, and web teams to design high-converting ad assets and landing page experiences tailored to ICP decision-makers.



What Success Looks Like



- High-trust tracking environments established across clients, ensuring 100% data alignment between ad platforms, analytics tools, and CRM pipeline reports.



- Shift in focus from vanity metrics (clicks/leads) to full-funnel efficiency, resulting in reduced CAC and higher demo-to-opportunity conversion rates.



- Clear experimental roadmap active at all times, leading to early adoption of profitable new acquisition channels.



- Executive-ready reporting delivered regularly, providing clear recommendations on where to scale, optimize, or reallocate ad spend.



Nice to Have



- Hands-on experience with emerging ad platforms like OpenAI Ads, Reddit, or CTV.



- Deep familiarity with enterprise B2B sales cycles, ABM frameworks, and public sector/enterprise SaaS marketing.



- Advanced experience with offline conversion tracking and custom CRM data synchronization.



Logistics

- Work Style: Async / High-Ownership

title: Data Scientist
description:
// The work



We make financial research videos. You build the data layer underneath them: pulling the numbers, cleaning them, and turning them into charts and information design that titles, thumbnails, and scripts get built on.



Most of this job is code. You'll be scraping SEC filings, hitting APIs, wrangling messy financial data into something structured, and producing charts from it. If you can't write the prompt that gets the data, this role won't work.



You don't need to be a finance expert. You need to be fluent with data and fast at learning. We teach you the rest.



/// What you'll do



Pull data from filings, APIs, and the web — write the scraper, handle the pagination, deal with the garbage formatting.

Clean and structure it. Reconcile inconsistencies across sources and periods.

Build charts and information design from it. Not screenshots of spreadsheets — designed visuals.

Dig into a trend and figure out what's actually in the data. Come back with a finding, not a dump.

Help shape the angle: what's the story, and why should anyone care.

Chase answers on your own. Come back with progress, not just questions.



/// What we need



Python and pandas. Comfortable, not "I did a course." You've built things.

Real scraping experience — requests/BeautifulSoup/Playwright, whatever you use. You've dealt with sites that don't want to be scraped.

You can produce a chart in code (matplotlib, plotly, D3, Observable — your choice) and you have taste about how it looks.

SQL is a plus. JavaScript is a plus. Working with financial data is a plus.

High agency. You move without being told. You go one layer deeper than asked.

Clear written English. We work async.



We can teach the domain. We can't teach agency, and we're not teaching you to code.



/// Not for you if



Your data work stops at Excel.

You need a BI tool to make a chart.

You need every task fully specified.

You go quiet when you get stuck.



/// To apply



Start with the word CADMIUM so we know you read this far.



Then do this, it should take you under an hour:



Pick any US-listed company. Pull its last 8 quarters of revenue from its SEC filings — by code, not by hand. Make one chart from it. Send us the code and the chart.



We don't care if the chart is beautiful. We care that the data came out of a script you wrote, and that the chart makes one point clearly.



Also tell us: one thing you taught yourself recently, and how.



We read applications that follow these steps. We skip the ones that don't.

title: Customer & Technical Support Specialist (100% Remote)

In this role, you’ll help customers resolve issues, answer questions, and ensure they have a positive experience with the products and services we support. You’ll investigate problems, troubleshoot technical issues, and serve as a trusted point of contact for customers while working closely with internal teams to drive resolutions.

Responsibilities



* Provide support to customers via phone,
, and chat.

* Ability to learn new systems, processes, and products quickly.

title: Facebook Ads Video Editor
description:
We're looking for a video editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for sleep, recovery, and natural pain relief, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING ---



You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including: –
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases – UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly – Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action – Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof – VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure – Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



--- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ---



We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to edit videos that: – Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds – Make the problem feel real and urgent – Show the product clearly and persuasively – Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention – Feel native to
 and Instagram – Communicate benefits quickly and clearly – Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof – Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes... then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing.



--- THE KIND OF EDITOR WHO WILL THRIVE HERE ---



You'll be a strong fit if you: – Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands – Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative – Can create multiple ad variations quickly – Know how to follow references without copying them blindly – Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow – Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused – Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast – Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



--- SKILLS & EXPERIENCE ---



Ideally, you have experience with: – Meta/Facebook ad creatives – Short-form paid social videos – Long-form VSLs or sales videos – Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing – Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with sleep, recovery, or natural pain relief.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY --- – Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references – Creating variations of winning ads for further testing – Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs – Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios – Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance – Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



--- WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU --- – $1,500 per month, full-time (40 hours per week), fully remote – Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives – The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue – Clear creative direction and fast feedback – Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for an editor who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



If you're an e-commerce ad video editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.



--- HOW TO APPLY ---



All applications go through this form. It's the only way to be considered:







It takes about 10 minutes and requires a short video introduction. Applications sent as a message, without completing the form, will not be reviewed.

title: Motion Designer Figma
description:
About the Role



We're a boutique branding studio based in the Netherlands. We work at the intersection of brand identity, strategy, and design execution. Our brand and design work is built in Figma, and we're now bringing that work to life in motion for social and beyond.



We're looking for a skilled motion designer to join us on a gig basis, with a clear path toward part-time and eventually full-time collaboration for the right person. Our graphic designer and creative lead design everything in Figma. Your job is to take those finished designs and turn them into motion: animated brand content, kinetic typography, logo reveals, and explainer graphics that feel as considered as the brands we build.



This is not an entry-level role, and it is NOT for someone who just started animating and is looking to grow into the work. We need someone who has already done this at a high level, repeatedly, and can prove it with published work.



What You'll Do



- Receive briefs via online meeting, written documentation, and finished Figma design files, then independently own the animation from static design to final motion

- Create animated brand content for social: kinetic typography, quote and statement reels, framework and process explainers, announcement and case-study pieces

- Produce logo animations, brand reveals, intros, outros, and motion stings from our identity systems

- Translate Figma designs faithfully into motion, respecting the original layout, type, and spacing

- Build reusable, editable animated templates so our best formats can be repeated across campaigns and clients

- Design transitions and motion polish, and add animated graphic layers where needed

- Deliver organised, well-structured project files (clean comps, logical naming, reusable pre-comps) and export to the correct specs for social (9:16) and web



What This Role Is Not



This is not primarily a footage-editing or videography role. We're after animated design, moving type, graphics, and brand motion built from our Figma work, not cutting and grading filmed clips. If you also edit footage, that's a bonus, but it is not the core of this role.



It's not for someone who only assembles presets or templates without understanding brand logic. We provide brand deliverables and expect motion that feels intentional, not generic default animation.



And it's not for someone who needs constant hand-holding. You receive the brief, ask the right questions upfront, and deliver, with proactive communication if questions come up.



What We're Looking For



Required:



- A strong showreel and portfolio of published motion design work that shows real craft in kinetic type, brand animation, and graphic motion. We will be looking at it critically

- Expert-level After Effects. This is the core tool of the role

- Excellent kinetic typography. You can animate type in a specific brand typeface so it feels designed, not defaulted

- The ability to work from Figma design files and translate static layouts faithfully into motion

- A strong sense of timing, easing, and pacing. Your animation should feel premium and considered, never stiff or templated

- Clean working habits: organised comps, logical naming, reusable pre-comps, editable project files

- Reliable communication in English, written and spoken

- Able to work independently from a brief with minimal back-and-forth



Nice to have:



- A templated, systematic way of working. You structure and document your files so our best formats become repeatable, as we intend to systematise our content

- Illustrator experience and comfort preparing or adapting vector assets

- Lottie or web-export experience, and familiarity with motion for digital products

- A sense for sound, syncing motion to audio

- Editing ability (Premiere) for the occasional mixed piece

- Prior agency or brand content experience



How We Work Together



Every project starts with a briefing call where we walk you through the use case, goals, and brand direction. After the call, we provide written documentation and the finished Figma design files. From there, you own the animation. We expect proactive communication if questions come up. No silence until delivery.



Compensation



This starts as a gig engagement, paid hourly, based on experience and portfolio. We pay well for the right person. Strong collaborators will have the opportunity to move into a structured part-time role, and eventually a full-time position as the relationship grows.



How to Apply



Send us:



- Your showreel and portfolio, links to published, live motion work only. No unlisted mockups or static frames. We want to see what you've actually shipped

- A short introduction: your background, the types of projects you've worked on, the tools you're expert in, and your hourly rate expectation



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a paid test project, one short motion piece animated from a real Figma brief, before we move forward. Applications without a showreel will not be reviewed.

description:
Company Overview

DrayEasy Inc is a steadily developing international enterprise. We are seeking a versatile HR Specialist based in the Philippines to independently conduct full-cycle human resource operations. This role emphasizes employee relations management, requiring candidates to be adaptable and detail-oriented in a fast-paced working environment. Fluent in Chinese is a strong plus.



Job Summary

The HR Specialist will be in charge of end-to-end recruitment, personnel transfer & separation, performance management, one-on-one employee counseling, staff care, and training arrangements. The ideal candidate must be independent, empathetic, proficient in employee communication, and familiar with employee risk management. You need to be process-driven, meticulous, and capable of adapting to a fast-paced remote working environment. Candidates with Chinese language proficiency will be given priority consideration.



Key Responsibilities

1. Full-cycle Recruitment: Publish job openings, screen resumes, conduct interviews, coordinate hiring processes, and complete talent matching according to department staffing demands.

2. Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage employee onboarding, job transfer, status adjustment, resignation and termination procedures; organize and file employee documents to ensure complete and standardized personnel files.

3. Performance Management: Assist in optimizing performance appraisal systems, organize regular performance evaluations, sort assessment data, follow up on performance feedback, and complete data statistics.

4. Employee Relations: Maintain daily communication with employees, respond to HR-related inquiries, properly handle daily employee relation issues, and build a positive team atmosphere.

5. Training & Employee Care: Organize employee onboarding training and deliver HR policy training; arrange one-on-one employee interviews and emotional counseling, track staff dynamics, and improve employee retention rate.

1. Minimum 2 years of solid HR working experience, familiar with recruitment, employee lifecycle management, and performance management processes.

2. Proficient in employee relations management, skilled in one-on-one counseling, emotional guidance, staff care and training.

3. Strong data sorting ability, rigorous and detail-oriented in daily work.

4. Excellent interpersonal and coordination skills to communicate with all-level employees.

5. Self-motivated and responsible, capable of independently handling full-cycle HR tasks.

6. Proficient in Office software, able to make training materials and maintain employee relation records.

8. Must have a power backup in case of power outages.

title: Shopify Product/collection Lister - Dropshipping Stores
description:
IMPORTANT: Start your application with a red apple emoji. Applications without it are not read.



WHAT THIS IS



We run multiple dropshipping stores across different markets and languages. We need someone to list products and full collections on our Shopify stores, correctly and consistently.



You will start with listing. Once you know our process and we know your work, this role grows into launching our Meta ad campaigns as well. That is a real next step, not a maybe. It is the second half of the same job and we would rather grow one person into it than hire twice.



Everything runs on a written SOP plus a Loom video that shows the whole process from start to finish. You will not be guessing.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Single products:

- Get a source product URL from us

- Request the import script in our Claude project and run it on your PC through Command Prompt (copy-paste, no coding needed)

- Send us the full output, including any errors

- Pull the size chart from the source, get it translated and converted to centimetres, then set it up in the Kiwi Sizing app and assign it to the product

- Check the live product page against our checklist



Full collections:

- Same process, but for an entire collection at once

- One size chart covers the whole collection, so you build it once and assign it to every product in that collection

- Check that the product count matches the source and that nothing was skipped



Quality control (this is the important part):

- Titles and colour names properly translated, no leftover words from the source language

- Correct photo showing for each colour variant

- Shoe sizes in EU, not US

- Prices and compare-at prices correct

- No leftover text from the source store: shipping promises, guarantees, city names, brand stories

- Size chart button appears on the product page with the right chart behind it



When something is wrong, you send us the product link and describe what you see. You never edit a script yourself.



WHAT YOU NEED



- Real experience listing products on Shopify. You have done this yourself, on live stores.

- Experience launching Meta ads. You will not use it on day one, but this is where the role goes.

- Experience with dropshipping stores specifically.

- You use Claude or ChatGPT as a working tool, not just occasionally.

- A Windows PC. Our import scripts only run on Windows.

- Very clear written English. All our communication is written. If we have to read a message twice to understand it, this will not work.

- Fast, stable internet.

- Flexible availability. You choose when you work your hours, but launches do not always fall inside office hours, so we need someone who can be reached and can pick up a task when it comes in.

- Attention to detail, and the discipline to follow a written process exactly instead of doing it your own way.



You will get access to our Shopify admin and an API token. We need someone we can trust with that.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Written SOPs and a Loom video walkthrough of the full process

- All accounts and tools you need

- Direct contact with us. Asking a question is always better than guessing.

- A clear path into launching our ad campaigns once you have the listing process down



HOW TO APPLY



Read this carefully. Applications that miss a step are not reviewed.



1. Start your message with a red apple emoji.

2. List the stores you have worked on. Names or URLs. Tell us what you did on each one: listing, ads, or both.

3. Answer these two questions:

   - How many products or collections have you listed in a typical week?

   - Which ad accounts have you worked in, and what did you launch?



We reply to everyone who does all three.
salary: 3-5 usd per hour based on experience

title: HR, Recruitment, Workforce Compliance and Rostering Officer
description:
Company: Iris Home Care



🕑Working hours: 8:00 am–5:30 pm, 



🗓️Monday–Friday, Brisbane time (AEST)

- one Sunday per month.



🧮 Starting rate: Approximately AUD $4.50–$5.00 per hour, depending on verified experience



About the position

Iris Home Care is an Australian disability-support provider. We are seeking a confident, proactive and highly organised professional to support recruitment, employee onboarding, workforce compliance and staff rostering.



This is a fast-paced, highly interactive role. It is not a quiet, low-contact or purely back-office HR position. You will communicate regularly with applicants, employees, support workers, participants and managers. You must be comfortable making telephone calls, asking direct questions, following up missing information and responding quickly when shifts require urgent coverage.



You do not need to be the loudest person in the room. However, you must be willing to speak up, take initiative and communicate professionally with many different personalities.



Key responsibilities



Recruitment and candidate management

- Preparing and publishing approved job advertisements.

- Reviewing applications against position requirements.

- Conducting initial candidate screening.

- Contacting applicants and completing telephone or video screening.

- Assessing communication skills, availability, experience and potential suitability.

- Scheduling interviews and maintaining accurate recruitment records.

- Completing reference and pre-employment checks as directed.

- Communicating professionally with successful and unsuccessful applicants.

- Maintaining candidate pipelines for current and future vacancies.

- Following up recruitment actions without requiring repeated reminders.



🧗🏼‍♀️Employee onboarding and workforce compliance

- Supporting new workers throughout the onboarding process.

- Collecting and checking required employment and compliance documents.

- Maintaining accurate employee files and compliance registers.

- Monitoring document expiry dates and sending reminders before documents expire.

- Following up missing, incomplete or expired records.

- Checking applicable identification, qualifications, licences, screening clearances, training records and other workforce documents.

- Ensuring information is entered accurately across approved systems.

- Escalating compliance concerns, discrepancies or overdue documents to management.

- Protecting confidential employee, participant and business information.



📆Rostering and workforce coordination

- Creating and maintaining accurate staff rosters.

- Confirming worker availability and communicating shift details.

- Managing leave, unavailability, cancellations and roster changes.

- Identifying vacant shifts and contacting suitable workers.

- Coordinating urgent replacement workers when shifts are cancelled.

- Monitoring unconfirmed shifts and following them up promptly.

- Considering participant needs, worker suitability, availability and required competencies when assisting with roster matching.

- Communicating roster changes clearly to affected workers, participants and management.

- Maintaining accurate records of roster decisions and communications.

- Escalating unresolved gaps, risks or service-delivery concerns without delay.



🗣️Communication, engagement and lead generation

- Responding professionally to staff and applicant enquiries.

- Building positive relationships while maintaining clear professional boundaries.

- Creating or scheduling one simple, approved social-media post each working day using ChatGPT.

- Responding appropriately to service enquiries and promoting our current service capacity.

- Supporting other reasonable recruitment, compliance, rostering or administrative priorities when required.



👣About you

We are looking for someone who is:



- Highly proficient in spoken and written English.

- Clear, confident and easily understood over the telephone.

- Warm, positive, energetic and naturally engaging.

- Comfortable making calls and initiating conversations.

- Confident following up people who have not responded or supplied required information.

- Calm and empathetic when dealing with complaints, cancellations, stress or strong emotions.

- Able to communicate firmly and respectfully when requirements must be met.

- Highly organised and attentive to detail.

- Able to manage frequent interruptions and changing priorities.

- Proactive, resourceful and willing to investigate solutions.

- Accountable for completing and documenting follow-up actions.

- Comfortable working with confidential employee and participant information.

- Confident learning and using different online systems.



Previous experience in recruitment, human resources, workforce compliance, staff scheduling, healthcare rostering, customer service or workforce coordination is strongly preferred.



Experience supporting an Australian employer, disability-support provider, healthcare service or other regulated workforce will be highly regarded.



👩🏼‍💻Systems used

We use:

- ChatGPT

- Google Workspace

- ClickUp

- Astalty

- Approved recruitment, telephone, communication and rostering systems



Experience with these systems is helpful but not essential. You must be technologically confident, able to learn quickly and willing to troubleshoot basic issues.



🎁 Lead-generation bonus

This position will contribute to lead generation by responding professionally to enquiries and communicating our current service capacity. Our social-media platforms have a combined audience of approximately 14,000 followers.



An additional AUD $50 bonus is available for each participant lead personally generated by you who:



1. Successfully completes onboarding;

2. Receives at least two shifts of support; and

3. Has their first two invoices paid.



Working arrangements



The ordinary work schedule is 8:00 am–5:30 pm, Monday–Friday.



The position may also require approximately one Saturday per month during the position’s usual working hours. The exact Saturday arrangement, break arrangements and paid hours will be confirmed before appointment.



✋🏼How to apply

Please reply with a short voice recording introducing yourself. Speak naturally rather than reading from a prepared script.



In your recording, please tell us:



- A little about yourself and your personality.

- Your current or most recent position.

- Your relevant recruitment, HR, compliance or rostering experience.

- Which part of this position you are most experienced in.

- Which part of this position you would need further training in.

- Your hobbies or interests.

- When you are available to commence.

- Whether you can work the required Monday-to-Friday hours.

- Whether you can work approximately one Saturday per month if required.



We will use the recording to assess spoken English, clarity, confidence, warmth and overall communication style. Applications without a voice recording may not progress.



Please be honest about whether this role genuinely suits your skills and interests. Nobody is equally passionate about every area, and we want to appoint the right person to the right position.



This role will not suit everyone. If the starting rate, working hours, telephone requirements, urgent rostering responsibilities or highly interactive nature of the work do not suit you, there is no obligation to proceed. We would prefer an honest decision now than waste your time or ours.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer — Laravel / API Integrations / BigBlueButton
description:
Hellooooo onlinejobbers!



We are a large Australian education company providing online and in-home tutoring to K–12 students.



We operate on our own custom platform that manages students, families, tutors, lessons, payments and operations. Our core application is built in PHP/Laravel.



We are now looking for an experienced developer to take ownership of a major new project: building a deeply integrated online classroom experience.



The Project:



We currently use BigBlueButton (BBB) for thousands of online tutoring lessons. BBB works well as the underlying classroom technology, but our current implementation is relatively basic and feels separate from the rest of our platform.



We want to change that.



Our goal is to build a deeply integrated, fully branded online classroom experience powered by BigBlueButton.



We do NOT want to build our own video conferencing technology. Instead, we want to use BBB for video, audio, screen sharing, whiteboards, presentations and other classroom functionality, while our platform owns the surrounding experience, integrations, resources and data.



Phase 1



Our first objective is to:



Remove Greenlight from the normal tutor/student experience

Integrate BigBlueButton directly with our Laravel application

Automatically create a unique BBB meeting for every scheduled online lesson

Allow tutors to click Enter Classroom directly from their dashboard

Allow students/families to do the same

Handle authentication and participant roles automatically

Create an Instant Classroom feature for tutors who need an unscheduled classroom

Customize BBB so it looks and feels like part of our platform

Connect each BBB meeting to the corresponding lesson in our database

Capture attendance, join/leave times, meeting duration and other available meeting data

Return this data to our Laravel application after each lesson

Build the integration in a reliable and scalable way



From the tutor/student perspective, they should simply feel like they are entering another part of our platform.



They shouldn't need to know that BigBlueButton is powering it.



Where We Want to Take It



Phase 1 is only the foundation.



Once the classroom is deeply integrated with our platform, we want to explore features including:



Lesson transcription

AI-generated lesson summaries

Parent-friendly lesson reports

Automatic extraction of topics covered

Homework and next-step extraction

AI lesson recommendations

Teaching resources available from within the classroom

Previous lesson information available to tutors

Student learning profiles

Curriculum mastery tracking

Tutor analytics and coaching

Student engagement analytics



We want every online lesson to eventually produce useful structured information for the tutor, parent, student and our internal platform.



Who We're Looking For



This isn't a role where we will provide you with a list of tickets and tell you exactly how to implement them.



We are looking for someone who can take technical ownership of this project.



You should be comfortable being given a desired outcome, researching the available technology, proposing an approach, building it and improving it over time.



Required Skills



You should have strong experience with:



PHP

Laravel

REST APIs and third-party integrations

MySQL/database design

JavaScript/TypeScript

Git

Linux/server environments

Webhooks and event-driven integrations

Debugging complex integrations

Reading technical documentation and independently learning unfamiliar systems



You should also be comfortable working across the boundary between backend and frontend development when required.



Highly Desirable



Experience with any of the following would be particularly valuable:



BigBlueButton

BigBlueButton APIs

BigBlueButton plugins

React

Node.js

WebRTC

GraphQL

LLM/AI APIs

Open-source software customization

EdTech platforms



Previous BigBlueButton experience is NOT required, but will naturally be advantageous.



If you are an excellent developer who is confident you can become deeply familiar with BBB and its documentation, we still want to hear from you.



Forecasting a 6 month project, with potential for permanent work.



Please reply with your experience and how you would tackle this project. If you meet requirements you will be invited to complete a paid BBB/Laravel challenge.

title: Full-Time Executive Virtual Assistant to the Commercial Director
description:
ECLAT HOLDINGS is seeking a capable, curious, and highly reliable Executive Virtual Assistant to work directly with its Commercial Director.



LOCATION

Fully remote

40 hours per week



START DATE

As soon as possible



COMPENSATION

₱90,000 every two weeks

26 payments / ₱2,340,000 annually

Full compensation applies from the first day.



ABOUT THE ROLE



The Commercial Director is responsible for introducing and promoting international architectural and interior-design materials and furniture in the Korean market. This includes developing relationships and arranging meetings with architects and interior designers in Korea.



Your primary role will be to help the Commercial Director:



• Arrange and coordinate meetings with architects and interior designers in Korea.

• Maintain accurate records of meetings and follow-up activities.

• Track the progress and results of these meetings.

• Help report this progress to the headquarters of each represented brand.



This is a full-time position for someone with demonstrated executive-assistance experience and professional experience in architecture, interior design, construction, furniture, or a closely related field.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Manage the Commercial Director’s schedule and calendar.

• Arrange, confirm, and enter meetings with Korean architects and interior designers into the calendar.

• Send meeting-request
s prepared or approved by the Commercial Director.

• Write short, professional
s to coordinate meeting times with clients.

• Follow up on proposed meetings and accurately track confirmations, cancellations, and rescheduling.

• Convert the Commercial Director’s recorded meeting notes into clear, organized meeting minutes.

• Enter meeting notes, contact information, progress updates, and follow-up activities into assigned C4C/CRM systems.

• Track the progress and results of meetings with architects and interior designers.

• Prepare structured updates and reports for the headquarters of each represented brand.

• Help keep brand headquarters informed of meetings, market responses, opportunities, and follow-up progress.

• Conduct research on Korea’s architecture, interior-design, construction, materials, and furniture markets using ChatGPT and other appropriate sources.

• Turn research findings into clear, well-organized written reports.

• Create professional PowerPoint presentations according to the Commercial Director’s direction.

• Learn new processes and try different research or problem-solving strategies when the first approach does not work.



You will communicate directly with clients for basic scheduling matters, subject to the Commercial Director’s approval. The role does not initially require independently writing complex commercial correspondence.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• University degree.

• Demonstrated executive-assistance experience.

• Demonstrated experience in architecture, interior design, construction, furniture, architectural materials, or a related industry.

• Excellent spoken and written English.

• Proficiency with PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Microsoft Teams, and Outlook.

• Practical experience using ChatGPT for research and work-related tasks.

• Ability to learn and work with different C4C/CRM systems.

• Ability to maintain clear and accurate records of meetings, follow-ups, and business-development progress.

• Strong reliability, initiative, curiosity, and willingness to learn.

• Openness to detailed feedback and trying different approaches to solve problems.



STRONGLY PREFERRED, BUT NOT REQUIRED



• A university degree in architecture, interior design, construction, engineering, or a related discipline.

• Some understanding of the Korean language.

• AutoCAD, 3D-modeling, or architectural-visualization experience.

• Experience researching the Korean architecture, interior-design, construction, materials, or furniture market.



HOME-OFFICE REQUIREMENTS



Applicants must initially have:



• A reliable computer; an Apple computer is preferred but not required.

• Fast and dependable internet suitable for daily ChatGPT use and video meetings.

• A functioning webcam and headset.

• A quiet, professional home workspace.



ECLAT HOLDINGS may provide company equipment after the first six months, depending on business needs and the working arrangement at that time.



COMPENSATION AND ENGAGEMENT TERMS



• Fixed compensation of ₱90,000 every two weeks.

• 26 payments / ₱2,340,000 annually.

• The stated compensation is fixed during the initial hiring process. Please apply only if you accept it; salary negotiations will not take place during initial hiring.

• Payment will be processed through the payment arrangement used by OnlineJobs.ph.

• This is an independent-contractor engagement.

• Paid Philippine public holidays, vacation leave, sick leave, health coverage, and 13th-month pay are not included.

• Full compensation applies from the first day; there is no reduced introductory rate.



Applicants may live outside the Philippines, provided they are eligible Filipino OnlineJobs.ph members, can consistently work the required Philippine-time schedule, and have a functioning OnlineJobs.ph payment and bank setup.



BRANDS YOU WILL HELP SUPPORT



Before applying, please spend some time reviewing the brands represented by the Commercial Director:



• MATTEOBRIONI

• Preciosa Lighting

• Seves Glassblock

• Mosa

• Grassi Pietre

• COCOON



HOW TO APPLY



 the following to:







1. Your résumé.



2. A personally written cover letter explaining:



• Why you are applying for this particular role.

• Why architecture, interior design, construction, architectural materials, or furniture interests you.

• What you learned from reading about some of the brands listed above.

• Any observations you have about Korea’s architecture, interior-design, construction, materials, or furniture market.

• How your experience and working style would help the Commercial Director arrange meetings, track progress, and report results to brand headquarters.



Your cover letter is an extremely important part of the application. It should reflect your own thinking, motivation, and voice.



Generic, copied, or templated letters that do not demonstrate genuine research are unlikely to progress.



Please conclude your cover letter with the following sentence:



“I have reviewed the required schedule and accept the stated compensation of ₱90,000 every two weeks.”



 SUBJECT



Executive Virtual Assistant Application – [Your Full Name]



SELECTION PROCESS



1. Résumé and cover-letter review

2. Video interview

3. A short 10–15-minute research exercise using ChatGPT

4. Final hiring decision



Candidates whose cover letters demonstrate genuine curiosity, thoughtful research, and a clear interest in the role will receive priority for interview opportunities.

title: Part-Time Social Media & Brand Coordinator-Please read 10 steps to apply
description:
**Remote | 15–20 Hours per Week | Long-Term Opportunity**



We are seeking a creative, organized, and brand-conscious Social Media & Brand Coordinator to manage the social media presence of two growing brands:



* **Elevation Individual and Family Therapy** — a multi-location mental health practice serving individuals, couples, families, and children.

* **Calm and Capable CEO (CCC)** — a personal brand focused on leadership, entrepreneurship, faith, business systems, and building a successful therapy practice without constant chaos.



This is not simply a posting position. We need someone who can understand the distinct voice and audience of each brand, turn ideas and raw content into polished posts, maintain a consistent publishing schedule, evaluate performance, and proactively recommend content that supports each brand’s goals.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Social Media Strategy and Planning



* Develop and maintain a monthly social media strategy for both brands.

* Create organized weekly and monthly content calendars.

* Recommend content topics based on brand goals, audience needs, current trends, seasonal opportunities, and performance data.

* Identify appropriate trends, sounds, formats, keywords, and content opportunities without forcing trends that do not fit the brand.

* Balance educational, relatable, promotional, community-building, and authority-building content.

* Recommend campaigns to increase engagement, website traffic, client inquiries, followers,
 subscribers, and brand awareness.

* Repurpose strong-performing content into new formats and across platforms.

* Monitor relevant competitors and industry trends to identify content gaps and opportunities.



### Content Creation and Editing



* Turn raw videos, voice notes, photographs, written ideas, and longer recordings into polished social media content.

* Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, YouTube Shorts, and other appropriate platforms.

* Add captions, on-screen text, transitions, branding, music, and calls to action.

* Create branded carousels, graphics, quote posts, stories, thumbnails, and other visual content.

* Write captions, hooks, headlines, calls to action, hashtags, and platform-appropriate descriptions.

* Maintain consistent colors, fonts, visual style, messaging, and tone for each brand.

* Adapt content appropriately for each platform instead of publishing identical content everywhere.

* Help organize and maintain a searchable content library containing raw footage, edited content, graphics, captions, and reusable brand assets.



### Publishing and Community Management



* Schedule and publish approved content accurately and on time.

* Ensure links, tags, locations, cover images, captions, and calls to action are correct before publishing.

* Maintain a consistent posting schedule across all assigned platforms.

* Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and audience engagement.

* Respond to general comments and messages using approved brand guidelines.

* Escalate clinical questions, complaints, negative feedback, media inquiries, partnership opportunities, and sensitive messages to leadership.

* Engage thoughtfully with relevant accounts and communities to increase organic visibility.

* Assist with maintaining updated bios, profile links, highlights, pinned posts, and platform information.



### Analytics and Optimization



* Review platform analytics weekly and monthly.

* Track reach, views, watch time, retention, engagement, follower growth, link clicks, inquiries, conversions, and other relevant metrics.

* Identify which topics, hooks, formats, and posting times perform best.

* Provide a concise monthly report explaining:



  * What performed well

  * What underperformed

  * Why the results may have occurred

  * What should be repeated, changed, or tested next

* Use performance data to improve future content rather than relying only on personal preference.

* Conduct simple A/B tests of hooks, covers, captions, calls to action, and content formats.

* Track content progress from idea through approval, scheduling, publication, and reporting.



## Brand-Specific Expectations



### Elevation Individual and Family Therapy



Content should feel professional, compassionate, inclusive, trustworthy, and accessible. It should help potential clients understand therapy, connect with the practice, learn about services, and feel comfortable taking the next step.



The coordinator must understand the importance of privacy when working with a mental health organization. No client information, testimonials, identifying details, or clinical content may be used without explicit authorization. Content must never diagnose followers, promise treatment outcomes, or provide individualized clinical advice.



### Calm and Capable CEO



Content should feel confident, polished, relatable, honest, encouraging, faith-aware, and practical. It should reflect the voice of a successful therapy practice owner who shares real lessons about leadership, systems, staffing, growth, and becoming a calmer CEO.



The coordinator must be able to preserve the founder’s natural voice rather than making the content sound generic, overly corporate, or AI-generated.



## Platforms May Include



* Instagram

*

* TikTok

* LinkedIn

* YouTube Shorts

* Pinterest

title: Homecare Caregiver recruiter
description:
We are a licensed home care agency serving seniors across South Central Minnesota. Our caregivers help older adults remain independent and safe in their own homes. As our service area continues to grow, we are hiring a full-time remote Recruiter who will take ownership of building and maintaining a steady pipeline of qualified caregivers. This role requires someone who understands that recruiting in home care is an operational function, not just a hiring activity. Your responsibility is to ensure the organization always has enough caregivers in the right cities so that seniors who need care can receive it without delay.



The recruiter will manage the full caregiver recruiting cycle, from attracting applicants to moving qualified candidates into the hiring process. You will actively manage job postings, communicate with applicants by phone, screen candidates, and maintain an organized recruiting pipeline. This role also requires close coordination with scheduling, HR, and leadership so that hiring activity matches the real staffing needs of the business. Success in this position means anticipating shortages before they happen and ensuring we always have caregivers available where demand exists.



This role involves a high level of daily communication with applicants and requires strong organization. You will review applicant flow, conduct structured phone screens, follow up with candidates who have incomplete applications, and ensure interviews are scheduled efficiently. You will also track recruiting metrics such as applicant volume, interview conversion, hires, and hiring trends by geographic area. The goal is to keep the recruiting pipeline healthy so the company can continue expanding services without staffing interruptions.



We are looking for someone who has at least two years of recruiting experience and is comfortable handling frequent phone conversations with applicants. Experience recruiting hourly workers, especially in healthcare or home care, is helpful but not required. Strong written and spoken English is essential, along with solid spreadsheet skills and the ability to stay organized while managing multiple applicants at different stages of the process.



The right candidate is reliable, calm under pressure, and focused on getting results. We value people who communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and approach recruiting with a problem-solving mindset. If you apply for this position, please include the word Apollo somewhere in your response so we know you read the entire posting.

title: Senior PHP / Livewire/ Laravel Developer — General Requirements
description:
Contract: 12-week initial term, extension expected

Engagement: Project-Based

Location: Remote — must overlap Australia / Sydney business hours (AEST/AEDT)

Time Tracking: TimeDoctor (screenshots + activity tracking) — required for the duration of the contract

Experience: 8+ years professional PHP / Laravel development

Working hours: 40 hours/week Monday to Friday

Positions: 3 — Clinical & Supplier Integrations, Business & Financial Integrations, Product Features

About the Project

We build and run a multi-tenant practice management platform used by healthcare clinics — patient records, appointments, clinical notes, prescriptions, invoicing, and reporting. The platform is a set of interconnected Laravel applications sharing a central PostgreSQL database, and we are progressively rewriting our main portal into Laravel + Livewire 3.

We are hiring three senior Laravel developers. All three sit on the same platform and share the same bar; they differ in what each owns. This document is the baseline every candidate must clear before their specialisation is considered. Each role has its own job description covering what it adds on top.



The Three Positions

• Clinical & Supplier Integrations — supplier and laboratory ordering systems, health-claims and rebate platforms, partner clinical networks. Correctness over speed.

• Business & Financial Integrations — accounting platforms,
 and calendar providers, payment terminals and banking APIs. Money and communications, both unforgiving.

• Product Features — new customer-facing features including AI-assisted clinical documentation and self-service financial tooling. UI-forward; the only role where Livewire is a hard requirement.



Requirements

Experience & Skills

• 8+ years building production PHP applications, with at least 5 years in Laravel (Laravel 9+), hands-on and current. 

• Large or long-lived production systems — code with history, constraints you did not choose, and users who noticed when it broke. A string of greenfield builds is a different kind of experience; this platform is not a greenfield.

• You have owned something in production — not just built it, but carried it, watched it fail, and fixed it. Be ready to talk about a specific failure in detail.

• Eloquent at depth — relationships, eager loading, query performance, and knowing when to drop to the query builder or raw SQL instead.

• Strong SQL — non-trivial queries, joins, indexes, and the ability to read a query plan and act on it. PostgreSQL preferred; MySQL transfers fine.

• Queues and background jobs — Laravel queues, Horizon, Supervisor or equivalent. You have debugged a job that failed silently in production.

• REST and web services in general — HTTP semantics, auth headers / bearer tokens, status-code handling, retries/backoff, idempotency, and what happens when a request times out mid-write.

• Reading code you didn’t write — much of this work is understanding existing systems before changing them. Comfort navigating an unfamiliar codebase is essential.

• Multi-tenant awareness — every record here is scoped by account and practice; getting that wrong is a data-leak class of bug, not a cosmetic one.

• Able to work independently — self-directed and comfortable owning a component end to end with minimal supervision.

• Testing & QA — can write unit and feature tests (Pest or PHPUnit), perform manual QA, identify and log defects, and verify fixes against acceptance criteria.

• Agentic Coding — familiar with Claude Code in coding, testing, and review in the workflow.

• Project Management — capable of lightweight PM tasks: tracking milestones, updating task status, flagging blockers proactively, and estimating remaining effort.

• Security Awareness — aware of data sensitivity and handling. This platform holds patient and financial records.

• Good verbal and written communication in English — clear and professional in async written communication (Slack, Jira, Confluence) and comfortable in spoken sync calls.

Tools & Workflow

• Comfortable working in our toolchain: Jira (issues/sprints), Confluence (docs), Postman (API testing), Sentry (error monitoring), and Bitbucket (source control / pull requests).

• Clean commits, clear pull requests, and clear written communication in English.



Not Required

• A degree. We care about what you’ve shipped.

• Livewire — except for the Product Features role, where it is a hard requirement.

• Tailwind or Alpine specifically — the fundamentals underneath them are what matter.

• Python or Django — helpful for reading legacy business logic, not a requirement.

• Healthcare or clinical software background — useful context, genuinely not a hard requirement.

• PostgreSQL specifically — strong MySQL transfers fine.



Working Arrangement

• Project-based. 12-week initial term with milestones agreed up front. Extension expected for the right person.

• Sydney business-hour overlap required for daily sync and quick turnaround on questions. A minimum of 6 hours of genuine overlap each working day is required — you don’t need to be Sydney-based.

• TimeDoctor is used for time tracking and is a condition of the engagement; please only apply if you’re comfortable with activity monitoring.

• Resources provided: codebase access, database schema documentation, and a staging environment to test against.



How to Apply

Please include:

• Which of the three positions fits you best and why. If more than one does, say so — we’d rather place you well than fill a slot.

• Relevant Livewire work — links or descriptions of comparable projects, and what you owned on them.

• Relevant Laravel work — links or descriptions of comparable projects, and what you owned on them.

• Links to any code you’ve written — GitHub, GitLab, personal projects, anything.

• Your experience with agentic coding tools — which you’ve genuinely used, one task you completed with one, and one time the tool got it wrong and how you caught it.

• Examples of working independently and owning a component end to end.

• Any Testing, QA, or light project management experience.

• Your time-zone and the daily hours you can overlap with Sydney.

• Confirmation you’re comfortable using TimeDoctor, Jira, Confluence, Postman, Sentry, and Bitbucket.

• A rough estimate / milestone breakdown for work of this shape, and your rate.

title: Creative Production Coordinator - Meta Ads Agency
description:
**About the role**  

We are a creative agency that produces static ads for e‑commerce brands running Meta ad spend.



You will own every step between “a client assigns us a task” and “the finished ad is in the client’s hands.” You will not design the ads or write the copy. Your responsibility is to ensure the right work reaches the right designer, returns correctly, and ships on time, every time.



We promise clients **48 hours** on a new task and **24 hours** on a revision. Your job is to keep that promise.



---



### What you will own  



- **Intake** – Monitor every place clients assign work (ClickUp, Notion, Airtable, Slack,
). No request sits unnoticed for more than 4 business hours.  

- **Brief capture** – Copy each client brief into our standard Notion card, word for word, including every reference image. Never paraphrase or summarize.  

- **Verification** – Before a card is sent out:  

  - Check prices against the live price sheet.  

  - Attach the correct product file.  

  - Verify banned words are excluded.  

  - Apply past client corrections.  

- **Dispatch** – Assign cards to designers, balance the load across the team, and chase any item that has not moved in 12 hours.  

- **Quality check** – Review every finished ad to ensure:  

  - Correct product is used.  

  - Approved copy is pasted (not retyped).  

  - Safe zones are correct for each size.  

  - Export settings and file naming are accurate.  

- **Delivery** – Post finished ads to the client on their platform, in our voice, and log the delivery.  

- **Revisions** – Capture client feedback word for word, set the deadline, and route it back to a designer within 24 hours.  

- **Reporting** – Send one short status message to the founder each morning; provide weekly numbers.  

- **SOPs** – If a question is asked twice, write it into the SOP.



---



### What this job is **not**  



- You do **not** choose the reference ads; you may suggest but never d
.  

- You do **not** write or rewrite ad copy.  

- You do **not** design. If a designer is unavailable, you reassign; you do not open Figma to fix it.  

- You do **not** handle pricing, scope, or strategy conversations with clients.  



If you are hoping this role will evolve into a creative or copywriting position, it is not the right fit.



---



### What we need from you  



- **2 + years** in project coordination, production management, or creative operations (agency experience preferred; paid social or e‑commerce strongly preferred).  

- **Notion** at a power‑user level: you have personally run a board with real statuses, relations, and filtered views, the core of the job.  

- Working knowledge of **ClickUp** and **Airtable**: you can open a client’s board, find the task, and read the brief without breaking anything.  

- Excellent written English: your messages go to clients under our name.  

- Obsessive attention to detail: noticing a $3 price discrepancy or an outdated bottle label is essential. If detail work drains you, please do not apply.  

- Ability to follow a written process exactly; when something is unclear, ask one short question, never guess.  

- Comfort with AI tools and willingness to learn ours; we run Claude inside our workflow daily, and you will use it.



#### Nice to have  



- Enough **Figma** or **Canva** experience to judge safe zones and export settings.  

- Experience onboarding freelancers or managing a small remote team.  

- Experience working to a service‑level agreement and understanding the pressure of a running clock.



---



### How to apply  



Send us:



1. A short note on the production process you have personally run, include the steps, number of people involved, and how you kept track.  

2. A description of a what tools you used and managed?   

3. Your answer to this scenario: *A client brief says the product is the 60‑capsule bottle, but the product folder only has the 30‑capsule image. What do you do?*



**Start your application with the word `CONVEYOR`** so we know you read the whole post. 



All applications which dont answer the above questions and don't use the keyword will not be considered.



Shortlisted applicants will receive a short paid test task using one real brief before we make an offer.

title: Influencer Sourcing Specialist
description:
Freelance Creator Sourcing Specialist (TikTok & Instagram)

Role Type: Contractor 

Location: Remote

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized and chronically online Creator Sourcing Specialist to help us identify short-form video creators for our growing ambassador program. Your singular focus will be discovery and lead generation.

You will not be responsible for DMing,
ing, or negotiating with these creators. Your job is strictly to find the right talent, vet their metrics, and hand off a high-quality list to our outreach team. IMPORTANT: WE HAVE A STRICT QUOTA OF HOW MANY INFLUENCERS WE EXPECT PER WEEK. ONLY APPLY IF YOU ARE ABLE TO FIND AT LEAST 500 INFLUENCERS WEEK VIA TIKTOK/INSTAGRAM APP. 

What You’ll Do

Deep-Dive Sourcing: Scour TikTok and Instagram to find short-form creators who align with our target demographics (specifically micro-influencers, sports tipsters, and engaging niche commentators).

Data Collection: Build and maintain an organized database (Google Sheets) of creator profiles, including handles, follower counts, and contact information if publicly available.

Quality Vetting: Ensure every sourced creator meets our specific criteria for engagement (not just follower count) and content quality, filtering out bots, inauthentic accounts, or off-brand content.

Market Focus: Identify creators who specifically resonate with Latin American audiences and produce content in Spanish.

What We’re Looking For

Platform Expertise: You know the ins and outs of TikTok and Instagram algorithms, hashtags, and discovery tools.

Analytical Eye: You understand that a high follower count doesn't always equal high engagement, and you know how to spot authentic communities.

Detail-Oriented: You take pride in building clean, accurate, and easy-to-read spreadsheets.

Cultural Fluency: Familiarity with LatAm digital culture and fluency in Spanish is highly preferred to effectively evaluate the creators' content.

Self-Starter: You can take a creator brief and run with it, delivering lists on time with minimal micromanagement.



How to Apply

Please send a brief introduction about your experience with social media research, along with a quick list of 3 TikTok or Instagram creators (handles only) that you think are currently producing highly engaging, sports or tech-adjacent short-form content for LatAm audiences. Also check out our website 
 for more information.
