title: Property Management Systems Administrator
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a tech-savvy and detail-oriented Short-Term Rental Systems Administrator to join our client's growing holiday rental business.



This role is responsible for the administration, optimisation, and ongoing support of the technology and property management systems that underpin the business's short-term rental operations.



A key initial project will be supporting the business's migration from Guesty to Resly. You will be involved in system configuration, data migration and validation, workflow setup, testing, documentation, issue resolution, and user adoption.



Following the migration, you will take ownership of the day-to-day administration and optimisation of the property management system. This includes maintaining property and operational data, configuring system settings, supporting users, troubleshooting issues, improving workflows, maintaining documentation, and identifying opportunities to use technology and automation to improve operational efficiency.



This role is ideal for someone who understands short-term rental or property management operations but is equally comfortable working inside software platforms, managing data, troubleshooting systems, documenting processes, and learning new technology.



You will become an important internal resource for the business's property management systems and will work closely with the team to ensure technology supports efficient, accurate, and scalable operations.



Key Responsibilities

Property Management Systems Administration

• Administer and maintain the company's property management system and related business platforms.

• Set up and configure new properties, including property settings, availability, pricing, fees, booking rules, and operational preferences.

• Maintain accurate property, listing, booking, owner, and operational data across systems.

• Perform regular data audits and system checks to identify and correct inconsistencies or errors.

• Maintain system configurations and ensure information remains accurate and up to date.

• Troubleshoot system and workflow issues and coordinate with software providers or relevant stakeholders when escalation is required.

• Act as the primary internal point of contact for property management system queries and provide day-to-day user support.

• Monitor system functionality and identify potential issues before they impact operations.

Guesty to Resly Migration & Implementation

• Support the migration from Guesty to Resly from preparation through implementation and post-migration support.

• Prepare, clean, validate, and organise data prior to migration.

• Configure Resly based on business requirements and operational workflows.

• Support the setup of properties, users, integrations, settings, workflows, and other system components.

• Conduct system testing and user acceptance testing to identify configuration, data, and workflow issues.

• Validate migrated data and investigate discrepancies or inconsistencies.

• Document issues, resolutions, system configurations, and key decisions throughout the migration.

• Support the team during implementation and assist with post-migration troubleshooting.

• Help develop user guides, SOPs, and system documentation to support adoption.

• Provide basic training and guidance to users as they transition to the new platform.

Systems Optimisation & Process Improvement

• Review existing workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

• Identify repetitive or manual processes that could be improved through system configuration, automation, or better workflows.

• Recommend improvements to system functionality and operational processes.

• Support the implementation of new system features, integrations, and business tools.

• Evaluate how different platforms and systems work together and identify opportunities to improve data flow and operational efficiency.

• Maintain an up-to-date understanding of the business's key systems and their capabilities.

• Participate in future system implementations, migrations, integrations, and technology projects.

Data, Documentation & Knowledge Management

• Maintain accurate and reliable system data across the property portfolio.

• Develop and maintain SOPs, system documentation, workflow guides, and user instructions.

• Document system configurations, processes, recurring issues, and resolutions.

• Maintain a reliable knowledge base for common system and operational issues.

• Ensure documentation is updated whenever systems, workflows, or processes change.

Operational Support

• Provide systems-related support to the property management and operations teams.

• Assist with property and operational administration where it directly supports the effective use of business systems.

• Support the onboarding and setup of new properties.

• Work with internal stakeholders to understand operational requirements and translate them into effective system configurations and workflows.

• Assist with ad hoc systems and operational projects as required.



About You

We are looking for someone who combines short-term rental/property management knowledge with strong systems, technology, and problem-solving skills.

Essential Experience

• 3+ years of experience in short-term rentals, property management, property operations, systems administration, or a closely related role.

• Hands-on experience using a property management system (PMS) or similar operational platform.

• Strong understanding of how property management or short-term rental systems support bookings, properties, availability, pricing, guest information, owners, and day-to-day operations.

• Demonstrated ability to learn and administer new software platforms.

• Strong attention to detail and a high level of data accuracy.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently, take ownership, and manage multiple priorities.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable working with system configurations, data, workflows, and process documentation.

• Comfortable supporting users and explaining system processes clearly.

Highly Desirable

• Hands-on Resly experience.

• Experience with Guesty and/or migration from Guesty to another PMS.

• Experience with PropertyMe, Hostaway, Lodgify, Conduit, or similar property management platforms.

• Experience supporting a system implementation, migration, integration, or major platform change.

• Experience with PMS configuration and setup rather than simply using the platform for day-to-day bookings or administration.

• Experience with data migration, data cleansing, validation, or system testing.

• Experience creating SOPs, process documentation, user guides, or knowledge bases.

• Experience identifying opportunities for workflow automation and process improvement.

• Familiarity with ActiveCampaign or similar CRM platforms.

• Experience working with multiple integrated business systems.

Working Style

• Naturally curious and comfortable learning new technology.

• Highly organised and methodical.

• Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger operational picture.

• Proactive in identifying problems and proposing solutions.

• Comfortable taking ownership of systems rather than waiting for instructions.

• Able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical users.

• Enjoys improving processes and finding better ways of working.

• Comfortable working during Australian business hours.

• Committed to delivering a high standard of service to internal stakeholders and supporting the effective management of the property portfolio.

title: Online Fitness & Nutrition Coach – Remote / Backend Coaching
description:
We are looking for an experienced and highly proactive Online Fitness & Nutrition Coach to join our coaching team in a backend coaching role.



This is NOT a general Virtual Assistant position.



We are specifically looking for someone who already understands strength training, resistance training, nutrition, fat loss and muscle building and wants to build a long-term career working inside an established online fitness coaching business.



What you'll be doing



You will work behind the scenes alongside our Australian coaching team to help deliver an exceptional coaching experience to our clients.



Your responsibilities will include:



Reviewing client weekly check-ins and progress data

Writing personalised client check-in responses in excellent English

Responding to client questions and messages

Reviewing exercise technique/form videos and providing feedback

Monitoring training performance, adherence, nutrition and client progress

Implementing approved training and nutrition adjustments

Updating programs, nutrition targets and client information inside our coaching software

Following our established coaching systems, processes and SOPs

Identifying clients who may be struggling, disengaging or at risk and escalating them to a senior coach

Keeping accurate notes so the wider coaching team always understands each client's situation



You will not initially be expected to independently make every advanced coaching decision.



Our senior coaches will provide direction where required. Your job is to understand that direction, execute it accurately, communicate exceptionally well with clients, and progressively become capable of handling more responsibility.



Who we're looking for



We care much more about finding a real fitness person who can coach than finding a generic VA who happens to have worked for a fitness company.



You should:



Personally train consistently and genuinely love fitness

Be in excellent physical condition yourself

Have a strong understanding of resistance training, hypertrophy, fat loss and nutrition

Ideally have a bodybuilding, physique or serious strength-training background

Have previous experience as a Personal Trainer, Online Coach, Nutrition Coach or similar

Hold a recognised fitness/personal-training qualification

A bachelor's degree in Exercise Science, Sports Science, Nutrition or a related field is highly regarded

Have excellent written and spoken English

Be able to communicate warmly, clearly and professionally with Australian clients

Be extremely organised and accurate

Learn new systems quickly

Be comfortable receiving feedback and implementing it immediately

Be proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do

Be confident using online software and learning new technology

The person who will thrive here



We want someone who sees a client check-in and thinks like a coach.



You notice problems.



You understand context.



You ask intelligent questions when something doesn't make sense.



You learn a process once and don't need someone standing over your shoulder every time you repeat it.



Most importantly, you genuinely care whether the client succeeds — even though you aren't the public face of the business.



How our coaching team works



Our Australian coaches remain responsible for key client-facing interactions and higher-level coaching decisions.



You'll work behind the scenes handling much of the ongoing written coaching, client communication, form review, program implementation and day-to-day delivery.



We also operate an internal client monitoring system. If a client's adherence, engagement, results or satisfaction begins declining, you'll flag them so a senior coach can personally intervene.



This position therefore requires judgement, not just task completion.



Requirements



Please only apply if you have genuine training and nutrition knowledge.



When applying, include:



Your fitness/coaching qualifications

Your previous coaching experience

Your personal training background

What your own current training looks like

Your experience with nutrition and tracking macros/calories

Any online coaching software you've previously used

Your current availability and desired weekly hours



Important: Start your application with the words “COACH FIRST” so we know you've read the entire job description.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of the coaching team, not someone looking for random VA work.

title: Meta Ads & Funnel Specialist
description:
We are an established dental clinic in Melbourne, Australia looking for an experienced Meta Ads & Funnel Specialist to join our team on a long-term basis.



This is NOT a general VA role and NOT a social media posting role.



We are looking for someone who genuinely understands paid Meta advertising, lead generation, retargeting and the entire customer acquisition funnel.



Our goal is not to generate the cheapest possible leads.



Our goal is to generate quality leads that turn into booked and attended dental patients.

What You'll Be Responsible For



You will take ownership of our Meta advertising strategy across
 and Instagram, including:

- Developing Meta advertising strategies for our dental clinic

- Creating and managing campaigns through Meta Ads Manager

- Developing campaign offers and funnel strategies

- Identifying and testing target audiences

- Developing creative concepts, hooks, copy and messaging

- Working with or creating basic ad creatives where required

- Lead generation campaigns

- Website conversion campaigns

- Retargeting campaigns

- Creating Custom Audiences and Lookalike Audiences

- Website visitor retargeting

- Meta Pixel setup and management

- Conversion/event tracking

- Conversions API knowledge/setup

- Landing page and Meta lead-form strategy

- A/B testing ads, audiences, offers and creatives

- Monitoring and optimising campaigns

- Managing advertising budgets

- Scaling campaigns that perform

- Identifying why campaigns are underperforming and making changes

- Reporting on campaign performance



You Must Understand the Entire Funnel



We are NOT looking for someone who simply launches
 ads and reports cost per lead.



You should understand the complete journey:



Ad → Click → Landing Page/Lead Form → Lead → Contact → Booking → Attendance



We already have a separate VA who will be responsible for contacting and following up leads.



You will work together with our VA so that you can understand what happens to the leads you generate.



For example, we want to know:



Ad Spend → Leads → Leads Contacted → Appointments Booked → Patients Attended



You should use this information to improve the campaigns.



If leads are cheap but nobody books, we do NOT consider that a successful campaign.



Retargeting Is Important to Us



We particularly want someone experienced in website retargeting.



For example:



A potential patient searches for a dentist → visits our website → doesn't book → later sees our clinic's advertisement on
 or Instagram.



We would like to develop retargeting strategies for people who visit different areas of our website, including services such as:



General dentistry / new patients

Cosmetic dentistry

Teeth whitening

Invisalign / clear aligners

Sleep dentistry

Other key dental services



You should be comfortable setting up and managing the tracking required to do this properly.



Who We're Looking For



You should have strong hands-on experience with:



- Meta Ads Manager

-
 & Instagram advertising

- Lead generation

- Funnel strategy

- Meta Pixel

- Conversions API

- Custom Audiences

- Lookalike Audiences

- Website retargeting

- Conversion tracking

- Landing pages / lead forms

- A/B testing

- Creative testing

- Campaign optimisation

- Campaign scaling

- Performance analysis



Experience with dental, medical, cosmetic, healthcare or appointment-based local businesses would be highly regarded.



Canva or other creative design experience is also beneficial.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term part of our marketing team.



Initially, we expect to start with controlled advertising budgets and test campaigns carefully.



If you demonstrate that you can consistently generate quality new patients, we are happy to increase advertising budgets and expand campaigns.



There is significant opportunity for this role to grow.



We Care About Business Results



We don't want reports that only tell us:



“Your CPC decreased.”



“Your CTR increased.”



“We generated 70 leads.”



Those metrics are useful, but ultimately we want to know:



How many new patients did the campaign actually generate?



We want someone who thinks commercially and understands that a $10 lead that never answers the phone may be less valuable than a $35 lead who books and attends.



What We DON'T Want



Please don't apply if your experience is primarily:



Boosting
 posts

Organic social media management

Posting content to
/Instagram

Basic Canva design

Following campaign instructions created by someone else



We are looking for someone who can develop the strategy, not simply execute instructions.

Accounts will be handed over gradually. Once fully ramped, you are expected to manage roughly 25 to 35 accounts that follow repeatable campaign structures.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- Review every assigned Meta ad account several times per week and identify risks, opportunities and required actions.

- Own routine optimisation decisions, including pausing underperforming ads, testing new variations and making appropriate budget changes.

- Diagnose underperformance using campaign, funnel, lead-quality, creative and account-history data.

- Build, launch and QA local lead-generation and awareness/retargeting campaigns.

- Handle and troubleshoot GoHighLevel and Zapier setup, lead routing, forms, landing pages, automations, test leads and tracking.

- Make sound creative decisions and confidently adapt or QA static ads using existing Canva templates when needed.

- Develop occasional non-standard campaign tests from a clear brief, then assess the results and identify useful learnings for other accounts.



SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



- At least two years of hands-on Meta lead-generation experience, with clear examples of decisions you personally made.

- Proven local-service lead-generation experience. This is required.

- Agency or equivalent multi-account experience. Managing at least 15 active client accounts at once is preferred.

- A strong understanding of campaign structure, optimisation, testing, creative fatigue, lead quality and performance diagnosis.

- Practical GoHighLevel and Zapier experience. You should be comfortable working with landing pages, forms, workflows, automations, lead routing and tracking issues.

- A good eye for static ad creative and confidence adapting and QAing existing Canva templates.

- Clear written and spoken English, strong organisation and reliable follow-through.

- AI-forward, with practical experience using AI tools in your day-to-day media-buying workflow. You should be able to use them to analyse performance, investigate problems and develop test ideas while checking the output and applying your own judgement.

- Comfort making routine decisions independently and explaining larger recommendations with evidence.

- Real estate experience is preferred, but not required. E-commerce-only experience will not be suitable for this role.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



- Full-time and exclusive from the agreed start date, 40 hours per week.

- Monday to Friday. Working hours have some flexibility, but you must be available for scheduled meetings and maintain reasonable overlap with Melbourne business hours.

- $2,000 to $2,500 USD per month, based on experience and demonstrated capability.

- After three months of continuous service, you will become eligible for a prorated thirteenth-month payment.



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject line: Senior Media Buyer | [Your Name]



Please send the following:

- Your current CV or resume.

- A three to five-minute Loom video using the prompts below.

- One or two relevant campaign examples, screenshots or case studies. Remove or blur confidential client details where necessary.

- Short written answers to the application details below.



LOOM PROMPTS



Walk us through one local lead-generation campaign you personally managed. Include the offer, budget, result, your decisions and the part you directly owned.



Describe an account that underperformed or deteriorated. Explain how you diagnosed it, what you changed and what happened afterwards.



WRITTEN APPLICATION DETAILS



- Your current location and time zone.

- Your years of hands-on Meta Ads experience and the highest number of active client accounts you managed simultaneously.

- The local-service industries and markets you have run lead-generation campaigns for.

- Briefly describe your hands-on GoHighLevel and Zapier experience. What have you personally built, maintained or troubleshot?

- Briefly describe how you currently use AI in your day-to-day workflow. Include one practical example and explain what you still check yourself.

- Your current employment, freelance clients or recurring commitments. Confirm whether you can move into a full-time exclusive role, your notice period and your earliest realistic start date.

- Your expected monthly compensation in USD.



Shortlisted candidates will complete an initial interview, a paid skills assessment and a final interview.

title: Book Keeper (Australia)
description:
Bookkeeper — anew Australia

Location: Australia (remote/hybrid considered) Reports to: GM / CEO

Employment type: Part-time (flexible, depending on candidate)

About anew

anew is a New Zealand-founded sustainable beverage brand producing plant-based, reusable bottles filled with naturally alkaline spring water. Our Australian business has scaled quickly — reaching 450+ doors in its first month of launch, with partners including BP, Ampol, Really Good people and the Provedores. As the AU business grows, we're looking for a detail-oriented Bookkeeper to own the books for our Australian entity, with scope to grow into a broader role across our NZ and US operations as the business expands.

The role

You'll own day-to-day bookkeeping for anew Australia (Anew Australia Pty Ltd), working closely with the finance and operations team to keep the books accurate and current as we scale distribution and retail partnerships. This is a hands-on role for someone who's comfortable working independently and wants to grow with the business — the AU entity is the starting point, with the opportunity to take on NZ and US bookkeeping as our multi-entity finance function develops.

Key responsibilities

Maintain accurate, up-to-date financial records for anew Australia in Xero

Process accounts payable and accounts receivable, including supplier invoices, distributor and retail customer payments, and reconciliations

Perform regular bank reconciliations in AUD

Reconcile sales and inventory data flowing from Shopify, Upstock, Zoho and 3PL/fulfilment partners into Xero

Support month-end close, including journal entries, accruals, and prepayments

Manage GST reporting and BAS lodgement, liaising with external accountants as required

Track distributor and retail partner invoicing and payment terms as the partner network grows

Maintain organised, audit-ready financial records and supporting documentation

Support ad hoc reporting and financial administration as the AU business scales

As the role grows: support bookkeeping and reconciliation across anew's NZ and US entities, and contribute to multi-entity consolidated reporting

About you

Proven bookkeeping experience in Australia, with solid knowledge of GST and BAS requirements

Strong working knowledge of Xero (essential); experience with Zoho One, Shopify, or 3PL/logistics platforms is a strong plus

Comfortable working independently and managing competing deadlines in a small, fast-moving team

High attention to detail and a methodical approach to reconciliation and record-keeping

Clear communicator, comfortable flagging discrepancies and working with non-finance stakeholders

Interested in growing into a broader, multi-entity finance role as anew expands

Bookkeeping qualification (e.g. Certificate/Diploma in Accounting, or working toward) preferred but not essential with sufficient experience

Why join anew

You'll be joining a lean, fast-growing sustainable brand at an exciting stage of its Australian launch — with real scope to shape financial processes now and grow into a wider role across our NZ and US markets as anew scales.

title: SURGERY MEDICAL BILLER
description:
We are seeking an experienced Medical Biller with a strong background in surgical billing and out-of-network (OON) claims who can manage the entire billing cycle from claim submission through final payment.

We need someone who understands that billing does not stop when a claim is submitted. The right candidate knows how to track claims, identify payment issues, work denials and underpayments, communicate with payors, and take the necessary steps to get claims paid correctly.

Responsibilities

Manage professional medical billing from claim creation through final payment

Bill and follow up on surgical and high-dollar claims

Manage out-of-network (OON) claims and understand the additional follow-up required for OON reimbursement

Work with Medicare, Medi-Cal, and commercial payors

Review claims for correct CPT/ICD-10 codes, modifiers, units, provider information, and billing requirements

Monitor aging and outstanding claims and take appropriate follow-up action

Research and resolve claim rejections, denials, and payment discrepancies

Prepare corrected claims, reconsiderations, and appeals

Review EOBs/ERAs for incorrect payments and underpayments

Follow up directly with insurance companies until claims are properly processed

Maintain detailed documentation of all billing and follow-up activity

Identify recurring payor issues and help develop solutions

Take ownership of assigned claims and ensure they do not fall through the cracks

Required Experience

3+ years of hands-on medical billing experience preferred

Strong experience with professional surgical claims

Out-of-network medical billing experience required

Experience managing billing from initial claim submission through payment

Working knowledge of Medicare, Medi-Cal, and commercial insurance

Strong understanding of CPT, ICD-10, modifiers, CMS-1500 claims, EOBs/ERAs, denials, corrected claims, reconsiderations, and appeals

Experience researching and resolving unpaid, denied, and underpaid claims

Ability to communicate effectively with insurance companies and escalate claims when necessary

Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through

Strong Plus

Previous Team Lead, Billing Lead, or Billing Supervisor experience

Experience training or overseeing billing staff

Tebra/Kareo experience

Experience with complex or high-dollar surgical claims

Experience with GAP exceptions, Single Case Agreements (SCA), Letters of Agreement (LOA), and out-of-network reimbursement

Familiarity with payer disputes and reimbursement negotiations

Who We Are Looking For

This is not an entry-level billing position.

We are looking for someone who is experienced, persistent, organized, and accountable. You should be able to review an unpaid or underpaid claim, determine what went wrong, and know what action needs to be taken next.

Our ideal candidate does not simply submit claims and wait for payment. We want someone who takes ownership of the account, follows through with the payor, and works the claim until appropriate reimbursement is received.

If you have strong experience in surgical billing, out-of-network claims, and start-to-finish revenue cycle management, we would like to hear from you.

title: TikTok Shop & Affiliate Manager — 3+ yrs REQUIRED (US Shop, Premium Beverage Brand)
description:
Read this part first

We are hiring ONE person to own our TikTok Shop. We are not hiring a VA who "has helped with TikTok Shop."



If you have not personally set up, run, and grown a TikTok Shop — recruiting affiliates, negotiating commissions, running sample campaigns, and watching GMV actually climb — please don't apply. We'll know within 30 seconds of reading your application.



If you HAVE done this and you're proud of the numbers, keep reading. This is a senior, long-term seat at a brand already in major US retail, and we pay properly for people who move the needle.



About us

We're anew — a premium bottled water built on a bottle made entirely from plants, independently proven to contain zero microplastics, zero BPA, and zero PFAS, filled with natural mineral water. It took a decade to develop.



We're on shelf in the US across Sprouts (400+ stores), Whole Foods, Costco, and Bristol Farms, and we operate across New Zealand, Australia, and the United States.



What we haven't cracked yet is TikTok Shop. That's your job.





What you'll own

Set up, optimise, and run the TikTok Shop end to end: seller account, listings, images, video assets, compliance, shipping, promotions

Build the affiliate engine. This is the core of the role: source creators, run open and targeted collaborations, negotiate commission, ship samples, chase content, and cut the ones who don't perform

Build a repeatable creator brief so affiliates produce content that converts — not content that just looks pretty

Manage TikTok Shop ads, Spark ads, and boosted affiliate content

Plan, run, and coordinate LIVE selling sessions

Manage the sample/seeding budget and keep it profitable

Track GMV, CTR, conversion rate, commission spend, and creator ROI daily — and tell us what you're changing because of it

Report weekly on what's working, what you killed, and what's next





Hard requirements (non-negotiable)

3+ years in ecommerce, with at least 2 years directly operating a TikTok Shop (US market strongly preferred)

Affiliate/creator recruitment at volume — you can tell us how many creators you've onboarded and what they generated

You've run TikTok Shop ads and understand the difference between boosting a winner and burning budget

Comfortable with numbers: contribution margin after commission, creator ROI, and knowing when a deal is unprofitable

Excellent written English — most creator outreach is written by you

Reliable internet and a machine that handles CapCut/Canva-level work

Real proof: shop names, screenshots, GMV, affiliate counts



Nice to have: beverage, supplement, wellness or other consumable/FMCG experience; video editing; a live-selling host network you can tap.





Please do NOT apply if

Your TikTok Shop experience is limited to being an affiliate yourself

You've managed a shop for under a year

You need a manager to hand you a daily task list

You're running three other full-time clients

You're going to send a generic copy-pasted application







Long-term, stable role with a founder-led brand already in major US retail

Real ownership. You will not be micromanaged. You will be held to results.





How to apply (follow this exactly — applications that don't are deleted)

Put "TIKTOK-ANEW-2026" as the first line of your application. If it's not there, we won't read it.



Then answer these, briefly and specifically:



Which TikTok Shops have you personally managed? Shop names/handles, product category, and the dates you ran them.

What was monthly GMV when you took over, and what was it when you left (or now)? Attach a Seller Center screenshot. Blur anything confidential — we just want the shape of the graph.

How many affiliates have you recruited, and what commission structure did you use? Tell us about one creator who blew up for you, and one you had to cut, and why.

Link one affiliate video you sourced or briefed that drove real sales.

Record a 90-second Loom or video introducing yourself and telling us the first three things you'd do in your first 30 days on our shop. Do 60 seconds of homework on our brand first — we can tell when you haven't.

What are you looking for monthly, in USD?



Applications that skip the video or the numbers will not be considered.



We move fast. Strong candidates hear from us within a few days, do a short paid test project, and can start immediately.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
Lead the creative operation. Then help build what comes next.



Creative Production is the center of this role at the start. You will manage our video editors, own the production system, raise the quality of the work, and move strong creative from brief to final asset without senior leadership having to manage every detail.



This is not a coordinator or virtual-assistant role. We need a proactive Marketing Operations Manager who can operate the day-to-day work and improve the system at the same time.



A note from our CMO



Before applying, watch this short video about the role, its expectations, and what success looks like:







About Veritas



Veritas builds complete Starlink Mini deployment setups: mounts, power, cables, cases, and accessories for consumers, work teams, and government fleets. We are a growing U.S. company with a small, high-output marketing team in the Philippines.



Role details



• Full-time independent contractor with fixed monthly compensation of $2,000-$2,500 USD, based on experience, leadership depth, and fit.

• Approximately 45-50 hours per week, fully aligned with Pacific Time.

• Philippine graveyard shift: roughly 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM or 12:00 AM to 9:00 AM, depending on U.S. daylight saving time.

• Fully remote and long-term.

• This must be your only job. No other employment, side hustles, ongoing freelance clients, or subcontracting.

• Occasional weekend availability when production, launches, or publishing require management coverage.

• You must live in Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna. There are no regular onsite office days, but occasional in-person meetings may be scheduled.



What you'll own



At full production, the team aims to deliver one long-form video and up to 14 supporting assets each week for
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.



PHASE 1: LEAD CREATIVE PRODUCTION



• Manage a two-person video-editing team, including their priorities, workload, deadlines, coverage, development, and performance. 

• Turn approved priorities into clear production plans, briefs, scripts, storytelling direction, B-roll needs, and deliverables.

• Own the production pipeline: capacity, assignments, dependencies, revisions, blockers, asset readiness, and delivery visibility.

• Review short-form, long-form, ads, thumbnails, static assets, carousels, platform versions, and other creative output.

• Evaluate the full story—not only whether one shot matches one line. Check hooks, pacing, B-roll, demonstrations, captions, CTAs, factual accuracy, brand alignment, and viewer flow.

• Give editors clear, prioritized, actionable feedback and verify that required revisions were completed correctly.

• Use performance findings to identify stronger hooks, packaging, formats, V2/V3 opportunities, and creative tests.

• Build and improve SOPs, review standards, production trackers, asset repositories, AI-assisted QA, and backup coverage.

• Coordinate minor corrections and urgent production support when needed, without turning the role into a primary editing position.



PHASE 2: ADD SOCIAL MEDIA OPERATIONS



Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date, once Phase 1 is operating reliably and you have demonstrated readiness for the expanded scope. At that point, you will also:

• Manage the current Social Media Moderator and future social media team members. 

• Own the publishing calendar, content inventory, platform schedules, launch pushes, and publishing verification across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.

• Ensure each platform receives the correct version, copy, CTA, description, tags, products, related content, links, and native-platform setup.

• Oversee community, marketing inboxes, important comments and messages, channel presentation, and routine reputation handling.

• Manage routine creator-partnership and affiliate operations, including communication, records, deliverables, logistics, and escalation.

• Own routine UTM, Bitly, campaign-link, profile-link, and destination-verification workflows.

• Review social performance and turn findings into decisions, tests, and coordinated creative recommendations.

• Build and maintain the social department’s processes, AI workflows, reporting, and continuity systems.



The responsibilities above describe the core scope of the role but are not exhaustive. As Veritas grows, you may also take on related creative-production, social-media, team-management, and marketing-operations responsibilities that are reasonably aligned with the position and approved business priorities.



You're a strong fit if you



• Have at least eight years of professional work experience, including at least three years managing teams and at least two years inside a creative or marketing function.

• Have meaningful corporate, in-house, agency, or field-based operating experience, not only freelance, VA, or task-based remote experience.

• Have managed a creative or video-production pipeline and can lead workload, quality, deadlines, coaching, and accountability.

• Are exceptionally strong at storytelling and can evaluate the complete story and business goal, not only technical editing details.

• Act without waiting for step-by-step direction and continuously improve quality, speed, visibility, and continuity.

• Use performance evidence and AI to improve decisions and execution while checking sources and protecting brand and product accuracy.

• Communicate clearly in conversational American English.

• Can sustain the graveyard schedule and occasional weekend coverage.

• Have reliable primary internet, backup internet, and backup power.

• Want one company to grow with for the long term.



How to apply



Use this subject line and at least 20 AP:

[INSERT REQUIRED WORD] - [X] years of professional experience - [X] years managing teams



Include the following:

• Your resume with company names, employment dates, role titles, team sizes, and whether each role was corporate, in-house, agency, freelance, or VA work.

• Have you directly managed a creative-production or video-production team? Answer Yes or No. If yes, state the team size.

• Can you provide examples of videos, campaigns, or creative projects you directly led if you advance to the next stage? Answer Yes or No. Do not send links or detailed explanations at this stage.

• In one short logistics block, confirm that this would be your only job and that you would complete all work personally. Include your city or province, most recent U.S.-hours role and actual schedule, primary and backup internet, backup power, and occasional weekend availability.



Note: Applications missing any requirement will not be considered.

title: Healthcare Quality & Compliance Assistant – Remote
description:
About the Role



We provide pharmacy consulting services to ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) and are looking for a remote assistant to help support our pharmacist and consulting work.



We are a small, close-knit company and are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of our team. This is not intended to be a short-term or temporary gig.



Who We're Looking For



Ideally, you have experience with quality assurance, compliance, auditing, accreditation, or quality control in a hospital, surgery center, clinic, or other medical setting.



A specific medical degree is not required. We are much more interested in someone who has experience with this type of work and enjoys it.



Responsibilities

Research healthcare guidelines, regulations, and updates

Help keep track of compliance requirements and reports

Follow up on schedules, outstanding items, and payments

Organize documents and information for our facilities

Assist our pharmacist with various administrative and research tasks

What We're Looking For



Someone who is organized, detail-oriented, good at online research, and able to work independently. We value someone who takes ownership of their work, follows through, and is looking for a stable, long-term position with a small team.



How to Apply



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Please include a short voice recording with your application. Tell us briefly about yourself and what you like to do for fun, followed by any experience you have with healthcare, quality assurance, compliance, auditing, accreditation, or similar work.
